title: Literature on Krea-2: does the text encoder keep knowledge in one place, as CLIP does in SD 1.x?
state: Basu et al. 2023 (README ref. 31): in SD 1.x the CLIP text encoder holds styles, objects and facts in its first self-attention layer at the last subject token; Basu et al. 2024 (ref. 20): not found in SD-XL or DeepFloyd. Our C77: Qwen3-VL first-layer attention off writes the prompt as text. Diffusion Lens (ref. 21) and ReFACT/TIME (ref. 30) are covered by C87 and C86.
next: Pre-register a causal-tracing replication on Qwen3-VL-4B: corrupt the subject tokens, restore one layer (attention or MLP) at a time, measure with DINOv2 and blind labels whether the character comes back; first on the encoder side, renders only for the layers that restore.
tool_rule: Yes (knowledge in one layer, as in SD 1.x CLIP): targeted closed-form edits of that layer become a precise tool for content. No (spread, as in SD-XL): text-encoder edits stay coarse, and style tools belong in the image model.

title: Shapes of the push along the dose: spiral, wave, clip (wrap-around), accelerating; whole encoder or per tap (no renders)
state: Run 2026-10-18: none of the four shapes; every MLP push bends once, early, in one plane (45-77 deg, no reversals, no jumps, turning concentrated at small push length); random pushes bend as much (66-88 deg) but less cleanly; identical across characters. next: Alessandro reads docs/te_shapes_result.md.
tool_rule: Straight or one plane: a knob is calibrated by push length. A shape the random controls do not share: the concepts are organised along it, and a knob must follow the curve. Clip: past some dose the knob reverses, so it needs an upper bound.

title: Shape of the push with very different prompts and much heavier edits (no renders)

Edit bends less than random at L06 and L28, not at L14.

Heavy doses that add a clip or a new bend: the knob needs an upper bound; if they only extend the straight part, the dose range can be widened safely.

title: The push's shape at every layer of the text encoder (no renders)
state: Run 2026-10-19: depth orders the bend (rho -0.655, deeper bends less); edit straighter than its random control in 24/35 layers, i.e. only from the middle on (+1 deg layers 0-11, -16 deg layers 24-34); attention past -1 is an algebraic mirror (d=-2 identity, d=-3 = d=+1), not a behaviour.
next: Alessandro reads docs/te_shapes_layers_result.md and the figures.
tool_rule: Depth orders the bend: a knob's dose curve is predictable from the layer, one calibration per band of layers. The edit bends less than a random push at every layer: the structure is in the learned weights, not in where the push enters. A clip at some layer: that layer's knob needs an upper bound.

title: Is the style switch a phase transition? Critical dose, seed fluctuations, mixed pictures
state: Proposed 2026-10-18 (Alessandro, from the Biham-Middleton-Levine traffic model: one simple rule, a sharp jam at a critical density, a narrow band of mixed states). C74: no style change below 0.70, L06 jumps around 0.80 in 4 of 5 strips, L14 slides; the elf rogue passes through a painted look. Language in the literature for sampling time: symmetry breaking (Raya and Ambrogioni 2023), speciation (Biroli et al. 2024).
next: Pre-register: L06 (step) and L14 (slide) at doses 0.60-0.90 in steps of 0.025, 3 characters x 8 seeds (312 renders per edit). Primary signature: the variance across seeds of the DINOv2 distance peaks inside the band and not at its edges. Then: width of the jump, blind labels of mixed pictures, critical dose per prompt, and when the picture commits during the 9 sampling steps. Renders need Alessandro's approval.
tool_rule: Transition: near the critical dose the knob is unstable and seed-dependent; calibrate outside the band, or use the band on purpose for hybrids. No transition: the dose is a smooth slider.

title: Map the basins: 2D slices of the conditioning around a picture on a watershed
state: Proposed 2026-10-18. Page 22: the half-formed hood (1 seed in 32) tips with 58 of 69 edits, from dose 0.02; block 10 positive lowers it at 0.04 and completes it at 0.16, crossing the boundary twice. Precedent for complex boundaries in networks: Sohl-Dickstein 2024 (trainability boundary is fractal).
next: Find 3-4 pictures on a watershed; for each, a 9x9 grid over two conditioning directions (edit direction x random direction) with Krea2ConditioningPush, 81 renders per map; colour cells by outcome; measure boundary shape and fragility (share of small random pushes that tip it). Renders need approval.
tool_rule: A fragility map tells where a knob is reliable (inside a basin) and where it is a lottery (near a boundary); a prompt can be scored for how close to a boundary it sits before editing.
